injuries.name: Jason Zucker
injuries.note: Zucker has spent the start of the regular season recovering from offseason sports hernia surgery, and while he appears to be trending in the right direction in his rehab process, head coach Lindy Ruff said Tuesday that the 34-year-old will still require "a couple of weeks" before he's cleared for game action. Zucker made 62 regular-season appearances for Buffalo last year and recorded 24 goals, 21 assists, 57 hits, 23 PIM and 21 blocked shots while averaging 15:37 of ice time.

injuries.name: Alex Lyon
injuries.note: According to head coach Lindy Ruff, Lyon is still without a timetable for return from the injury he suffered late in the preseason. However, his presence at Tuesday's optional morning skate is a sign that he could be somewhat near returning. The 33-year-old netminder had a strong 2025-26 regular season, where he posted a 20-10-4 record, a 2.77 GAA and a .906 save percentage across 36 appearances. In his absence, Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen should continue to serve as the lead option between the pipes and Colten Ellis should see an increased role as well.

injuries.name: Conor Timmins
injuries.note: After getting hurt in Saturday's preseason finale against Pittsburgh, Timmins is on injured reserve for the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign. He registered eight assists, 44 shots on goal, 81 blocked shots and 29 hits in 39 regular-season appearances with Buffalo in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Topias Leinonen
injuries.note: Leinonen will probably report to AHL Rochester when he's ready to return to game action. He sustained the injury during the offseason.

injuries.name: Brock Faber
injuries.note: Faber left Friday's preseason contest against the Stars in the second period with his confirmed skull fracture. The 24-year-old's status will be closely monitored in the coming days until a timetable for his return is provided. Faber's role is not one that can be easily filled, as he exploded for 15 goals, 51 points, 173 shots on net and 148 blocked shots across 80 regular-season games in the 2025-26 campaign. He's a worthy candidate to occupy the IR spot in fantasy until he's able to return to Minnesota's top defensive pairing.

injuries.name: Filip Gustavsson
injuries.note: Gustavsson is expected to be out until at least early November. He posted a 28-15-6 record with two shutouts, a 2.69 GAA and a .903 save percentage in 50 appearances for Minnesota during the 2025-26 regular season. Once he returns, Gustavsson will be in the mix for starts with Jesper Wallstedt.

injuries.name: Josh Doan
injuries.note: Lower Body: Doan is dealing with a lower-body injury that limited him late in Tuesday's (Oct. 6) game versus the Wild, Mike Harrington of The Buffalo News reports.

injuries.name: Topias Leinonen
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Buffalo Sabres placed G Topias Leinonen on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Alex Lyon
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Buffalo Sabres placed G Alex Lyon on injured reserve and was spotted practicing at Tuesday's (Oct. 6) optional morning skate.

injuries.name: Jack Rathbone
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Buffalo Sabres placed D Jack Rathbone on injured reserve non-roster list on Monday (Sep. 28).

injuries.name: Conor Timmins
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Buffalo Sabres placed D Conor Timmins on injured reserve and does not have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com.

injuries.name: Jason Zucker
injuries.note: Abdomen: The Buffalo Sabres placed F Jason Zucker on injured reserve and is still a couple of weeks away from recovering as of Tuesday (Oct. 6).

injuries.name: Brock Faber
injuries.note: Skull: The Minnesota Wild placed D Brock Faber on injured reserve and is without a timetable to return.
